verdict: REVISE by six named editorial/teaching corrections; conditional authored-teaching acceptance, no mechanical/card promotion

corrections.title: Teach mandatory stance selection and complete Mira’s two-turn state

edits.section: What happens on your turn, immediately after the turn-resource table
edits.old: | Reaction | Use a legal trigger when the resource is available. It refreshes at your regular turn's start. |
edits.replacement:
| Reaction | Use a legal trigger when the resource is available. It refreshes at your regular turn's start. |

A stance is also a required regular-turn choice. Choose one during your regular turn before the first attack, spell, relevant check/save or movement that would use its benefit or restriction; if none occurs, choose before turn end. It lasts until your next regular-turn start. Selection is not retroactive, and an extra turn neither selects a new stance nor replenishes its spent allowance. Use the complete Aggressive, Guarded, Mobile, Focused or Carrying procedure in the [combat guide](../mechanics/COMBAT_ACTION_PLAYTEST.md#stances); do not assume a neutral default. The choices can change AC, movement, damage or Reaction permission.

edits.old: At a regular turn's start, follow the combat guide's ordered processing: expire start-ending effects, refresh Reaction and tick eligible clocks, process due recovery, make a required death save, then resolve other start effects before voluntary choices. Extra turns do not refresh these regular-turn clocks by themselves. Changing initiative never restarts an existing duration.
edits.replacement: At a regular turn's start, follow the combat guide's ordered processing: expire start-ending effects, refresh Reaction and tick eligible clocks, process due recovery, make a required death save, then resolve other start effects before voluntary choices. Extra turns do not refresh these regular-turn clocks by themselves. Changing initiative never restarts an existing duration. After mandatory start processing, prompt the player to choose one stance before the first event that would use its benefit or restriction, or before turn end if no such event occurs. Apply its actual AC, movement, damage and Reaction consequences; do not supply an unprinted neutral stance. Extra turns retain the existing stance and its spent allowances.

edits.section: §5 Work through two Bard turns, step 1
edits.old: 1. **First turn, Action:** Mira starts Verse of Courage. This first performance gains 1 Crescendo. Her roll 7 + 5 hits AC 12; the d6 shows 4. The enemy falls from 30 to 26 HP. The other ally receives the card's encouragement.
edits.replacement: 1. **First regular turn, stance then Action:** Mira chooses Mobile before acting. For this example she makes no movement or opportunity attack, so Mobile changes none of the listed AC, Speed, attack or damage values. It grants no free movement. Mira starts Verse of Courage. This first performance gains 1 Crescendo. Her roll 7 + 5 hits AC 12; the d6 shows 4. The enemy falls from 30 to 26 HP. The other ally receives the card's encouragement.

edits.section: §5 Work through two Bard turns, step 5
edits.old: 5. **Second turn, Action:** Mira pays her last RP for Dissonant Note. RP becomes 0 and its recharge becomes 2. It is the first performance since the damage reset, so Crescendo becomes 1. The enemy's WIS save totals 7 against DC 13 and fails. Its Reaction is unavailable until Mira's next regular-turn start. Assume it is not concentrating; there is no concentration save. It is not Stunned and can still act normally within its other restrictions.
edits.replacement: 5. **Second turn, stance then Action:** After the automatic start effects in step 4 resolve, Mira chooses Mobile again before acting. She again makes no movement or opportunity attack. Mira pays her last RP for Dissonant Note. RP becomes 0 and its recharge becomes 2. It is the first performance since the damage reset, so Crescendo becomes 1. The enemy's WIS save totals 7 against DC 13 and fails. Its Reaction is unavailable until Mira's next regular-turn start. Assume it is not concentrating; there is no concentration save. It is not Stunned and can still act normally within its other restrictions.

corrections.title: Keep spell repetition history through Retune; reset it at a beneficial long rest

edits.old: | Beneficial completed short rest | Retune once: recover `max(0, round-half-up(maximum RP / 4) + primary RP class casting modifier)`, capped at maximum; clear Dissonance. |
edits.replacement: | Beneficial completed short rest | Retune once: recover `max(0, round-half-up(maximum RP / 4) + primary RP class casting modifier)`, capped at maximum; clear Dissonance. Keep the remembered ordinary-spell name and Refrain counter unless an actual class feature expressly resets them. |

edits.old: | Beneficial completed long rest | Restore RP to maximum and clear Dissonance. |
edits.replacement: | Beneficial completed long rest | Restore RP to maximum, clear Dissonance, clear the remembered ordinary-spell name and reset its Refrain counter to 0. |

edits.old: Retune at an eligible short-rest completion restores the amount on the Resonance reference and clears Dissonance. A beneficial long rest restores the RP pool and clears Dissonance. Other resources recover only by their own rules. Rest, healing and leveling are different events; gaining a level does not refill spent resources or current HP.
edits.replacement: Retune at an eligible short-rest completion restores the amount on the Resonance reference and clears Dissonance, but keeps the remembered ordinary-spell name and Refrain counter unless an actual class feature expressly resets them. A beneficial completed long rest restores the RP pool, clears Dissonance, clears that remembered name and resets the Refrain counter to 0. Other resources recover only by their own rules. Rest, healing and leveling are different events; gaining a level does not refill spent resources or current HP.

edits.section: §8 Recover, then advance only when earned, first paragraph
edits.old: After the party actually reaches a permitted recovery opportunity, a completed beneficial one-hour short rest allows Retune. For Mira, the recovery calculation is **round-half-up(2 ÷ 4) + 3 = 1 + 3 = 4**, capped by the 2-RP maximum. From 0 RP she returns to 2, and Dissonance clears. She gains no spare RP from the excess calculation. Track HP treatment and Hit Dice separately; quoting Retune is not healing. The ordinary limit is two beneficial short rests between beneficial long rests, with one beneficial long rest per 24 elapsed hours.
edits.replacement: After the party actually reaches a permitted recovery opportunity, a completed beneficial one-hour short rest allows Retune. For Mira, the recovery calculation is **round-half-up(2 ÷ 4) + 3 = 1 + 3 = 4**, capped by the 2-RP maximum. From 0 RP she returns to 2, and Dissonance clears. She gains no spare RP from the excess calculation. Track HP treatment and Hit Dice separately; quoting Retune is not healing. The ordinary limit is two beneficial short rests between beneficial long rests, with one beneficial long rest per 24 elapsed hours. Retune does not clear Mira's remembered ordinary-spell name or Refrain counter. In the §7 sequence, a short rest after the fifth turn clears Dissonance but leaves Message and its second-repeat history; another legal Message would be the third repeat and add 3 Dissonance. A beneficial completed long rest instead clears the remembered name and resets that counter, so the next legal Message begins a new sequence.

edits.section: Teach the current magic configuration, rest paragraph
edits.old: The [Strain guide](../mechanics/STRAIN_PLAYTEST.md) caps beneficial rests: two short rests between beneficial long rests, and one long rest per 24 elapsed hours. Track completion times. An additional safe Rest Watch can clear eligible Rest Debt without granting another resource refill. Rest does not automatically remove Wounds or resolve supply and security questions.
edits.replacement: The [Strain guide](../mechanics/STRAIN_PLAYTEST.md) caps beneficial rests: two short rests between beneficial long rests, and one long rest per 24 elapsed hours. Track completion times. An additional safe Rest Watch can clear eligible Rest Debt without granting another resource refill. Rest does not automatically remove Wounds or resolve supply and security questions. Retune clears Dissonance but preserves ordinary-spell repetition history unless a specific feature changes it. A beneficial completed long rest also clears the remembered ordinary-spell name and resets Refrain to 0; a debt-clearing Rest Watch without another permitted beneficial long rest does not supply those resource/history resets.

corrections.title: Complete the player-facing healer-kit stabilization predicate
governingSources: DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/EQUIPMENT_ITEM_PROCEDURES.md, introductory use rule and Medicine and alchemy healer-kit row (lines 5–13)

edits.section: Help someone at zero HP, opening sentence of the stabilization paragraph
edits.old: Use an Action and a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check to stabilize a living dying creature, or an Action and one healer's-kit use for automatic stabilization.
edits.replacement: Use an Action and a DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check to stabilize a living dying creature under the Core procedure. Alternatively, an Action and one actual healer's-kit charge automatically stabilize an adjacent living dying creature; this requires an available hand and access to the kit under the [item procedures](../mechanics/EQUIPMENT_ITEM_PROCEDURES.md#medicine-and-alchemy). Normal retrieval and hand-occupancy rules still apply. Stabilization alone restores no HP; an actual feature such as Trauma Response supplies only its own additional recovery.

corrections.title: Make the worked intervention premises and Bard notation explicit
governingSources: DescentReviewChanges/ReviewBible/docs/mechanics/BARD_PLAYTEST_v0_1.md §§ At the table; Crescendo and rhythm; Actions, recharge and concentration; Healing, damage and Echoes

edits.section: §2 Select four Base abilities and four ordinary spells, notation sentence
edits.old: **Performance attack +5; performance DC 13; S = 1 and C = 3.**
edits.replacement: **Performance attack +5; performance DC 13; S = 1 song die and C = max(1, Charisma modifier) = 3.** C is the printed-effect Charisma value, not Mira's changing Crescendo stack count.

edits.section: §6 Compare three different interventions, Healing paragraph
edits.old: **Healing with 2 RP.** Mira starts Chant of Renewal on a living ally at 3/10 HP within 15 feet. She pays 2 RP, starts concentration and rolls a 4: **4 + C 3 = 7 healing**, bringing the ally to 10 HP. At 0 RP she cannot pay the next turn's 1-RP maintenance. Without a genuine intervening recovery, the Chant ends at that turn's end with no second pulse. The selected feature can offer three pulses; her current resources fund only one. It removes no Wound.
edits.replacement: **Healing with 2 RP.** At her regular-turn start in this separate genuine encounter, Mira has 2 RP, 0 Crescendo, no last performance and no concentration. After mandatory start processing, she chooses Mobile before her first performance of the turn. She and the target satisfy the Chant's actual voice, hearing, perception and line-of-effect requirements. The living ally is at 3/10 normal HP within 15 feet, has no Wounds or other healing modifiers/blockers, and has not received Chant of Renewal healing this round. Mira starts the Chant, pays 2 RP, starts concentration and rolls a 4: **4 + C 3 = 7 healing**, bringing the ally to 10 HP. Starting gains the one eligible Crescendo stack, not a five-stack rider. At 0 RP she cannot pay the next turn's 1-RP maintenance. Without a genuine intervening recovery, the Chant ends at that turn's end with no second pulse. The selected feature can offer three pulses; her current resources fund only one. This is no Wound treatment, free Echo or reset of the preceding encounter.

edits.section: §6 Compare three different interventions, Shield paragraph
edits.old: **Preventing a hit with 2 RP and an available Reaction.** When Mira becomes the legal target of an attack, she can commit Shield before that attack resolves, using her available components and flute focus. AC becomes 18. An attack total of 15 then misses. RP becomes 0, and a first ordinary rank-1 cast adds 1 Dissonance. Shield expires at her next regular-turn start. Casting it after HP has already been lost would be too late. A previously spent Reaction would also prevent activation.
edits.replacement: **Preventing a hit with 2 RP and an available Reaction.** In this separate fixture, Mira is in Mobile stance and has 2 RP, 0 Dissonance, no remembered ordinary spell and an available Reaction, with no condition barring the cast. Before the trigger, her flute is already held in a hand containing no other object; she can provide V and use that hand for S/F. This does not grant a free off-turn draw. When Mira becomes the legal target of an attack, she can commit Shield before that attack resolves. AC becomes 18. An attack total of 15 then misses. RP becomes 0, and a first ordinary rank-1 cast adds 1 Dissonance. Shield expires at her next regular-turn start. Casting it after HP has already been lost would be too late. A previously spent Reaction, an applicable Reaction prohibition, missing components or only 1 RP would prevent activation. Keep the spell's actual trigger; this example does not introduce an outside game's casting window.
